title: What Is Theme?
skills: define theme and distinguish it from topic or subject
identify thematic ideas developed across a literary text
infer a theme from characters, conflicts, events, and recurring patterns
support thematic interpretations with relevant textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces theme as a broader idea or message developed through a literary work and helps students distinguish theme from topic or plot. Supports close reading, inference, textual evidence, thematic analysis, and literary interpretation across high school English courses.
